scientific_integrity.original_model_attribution: The Fourier transform and stochastic rate-refresh model are from Arutkin and Reuveni (2025).
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Renewal resolvent, Stieltjes inversion, simple pole residue, positive heat-kernel mixture and explicit weak-refresh asymptotics.

scientific_limitations: Stationary, one-dimensional Brownian diffusion with exponentially distributed redraw rates and independent Poisson environmental refresh.
No finite-distance guarantee for the isolated spectral mode when its mass is exponentially small.
No generalization to other environmental laws, quenched mu=0, or first-passage observables.
Potential broader rank-one perturbation theory may contain an implicit specialization.
title: An isolated spectral tail hidden by fluctuating-rate Brownian resetting
